name: src/composables/useSimulationStore.ts
observations: Dynamically imports WASM: import('@/wasm/ecosim/pkg/ecosim') and wasm binary url import
Constructs wasmWorld = new World(2000,2000,seed)
Bridges config via set_config(buildWasmConfig()) and brain mode via set_brain_mode()
Reads simulation state via creatures_json()/plants_json()/corpses_json()
Optionally calls env_costs_json() and corpse_costs_json()
Spawns entities via spawn_creature()/spawn_plant() when present
Maintains JS fallback when wasmWorld is null
Consumes Zegion modules: getZegionSpec, RNG, ActivationRegistry
Dynamically imports '@/wasm/ecosim/pkg/ecosim' and '@/wasm/ecosim/pkg/ecosim_bg.wasm?url'
Initializes WASM module then constructs World instance and stores as wasmWorld
On init, calls wasmWorld.set_brain_mode(simulationParams.brainMode) and wasmWorld.set_config(buildWasmConfig()) if available
Watches simulation params and calls wasmWorld.set_config(buildWasmConfig()) on changes
During step loop, calls wasmWorld.step(dt), then reads wasmWorld.creatures_json(), wasmWorld.plants_json(), and optionally wasmWorld.corpses_json(), env_costs_json(), corpse_costs_json()
Supports spawning via wasmWorld.spawn_creature(x,y) and wasmWorld.spawn_plant(x,y,r) with JS fallbacks
Syncs bad brain hashes to WASM via wasmWorld.set_bad_brain_hashes([...]) when available
